description: This file defines a publicly accessible interface 'IFSharpBaseInterface' with asynchronous methods for echoing values and handling multiple parameters.

methods.name: Echo
methods.description: Asynchronous method that takes an integer and returns a Task wrapping an integer.

methods.name: MultipleParameterEcho
methods.description: Asynchronous method that takes a string and an integer, returning a Task with a tuple of a string and an integer.
